title: Fairness allows another point of view

captions.physics: Supporting each other through definite responsibility
captions.energy: Seeking an honest measure of help

meaning: Your care can be fair when a clear division of responsibilities allows your view of the actual need to change.
text: An equal division of tasks may still leave a request for support unanswered. In the physical position of Anahata, the Emperor expresses care through responsibility and kept agreements. Justice in energy directs attention towards an honest measure, considering both people’s effort and making unseen demands visible. The Hanged Man in emotions describes a pause in familiar understanding. An unexpected clarification may reveal that the previous calculation showed only part of the situation. The pause lets you see support from the recipient’s position without declaring earlier efforts meaningless.

For example, you fairly divide preparations for visitors. It turns out that one person is worried about an approaching conversation rather than the number of tasks. **Sometimes fair help begins by reconsidering the question itself.** You can finish what is necessary and sit together briefly before the doorbell rings. Responsibilities remain, but involvement now addresses a living need. Someone beside you can hear a clarification even after everything has been carefully distributed.

The difficulty is becoming suspended between the former arrangement and the new view. You understand that responsibilities are not the whole issue, yet fear offering an insufficiently precise gesture. The pause leaves care without action and the other person waiting longer. A manageable, welcomed act can appear before complete understanding: it needs a heard request rather than a perfect explanation of everything taking place.
